scope: Synchronize the existing real TCP thumbnail disconnect regression with the reader actually beginning its response. Production code is unchanged by this test correction.

original_ci.error: thumbnail_cache_test.go:468: HTTP reader has no kernel pin; response had returned 409, reconcile Busy=0.

cause: Source-level sequencing error: state=cached publication occurs before OpenThumbnail acquires its kernel read pin. Test could expire/delete the artifact between those events. CI 409 is consistent with that race; this does not establish causes of unrelated failures.
change: Wait for an actual successful HTTP response before expiring the row.
Capture the body-read error so cancellation after headers is tested instead of relying on Client.Do to fail before headers.

Use 16 KiB/s so the first 16 KiB paced write reaches the client near one second; the larger JPEG stays in flight. Preserve 8-second response watchdog, Busy=1/pending assertion, actual cancellation, 3-second release/reconcile checks and zero remaining charge.

initial_local_attempt.error: thumbnail response did not begin before deadline
initial_local_attempt.detail: Waiting for a client response at the old 1 KiB/s rate conflicts with a 16 KiB paced chunk and 8-second watchdog. This failed attempt is retained; no deadline assertion was widened.

limits: Three local real TCP race runs are evidence for the corrected synchronization; new-head Linux CI is still required. The unrelated PDF CI regression remains open.
